Definition: adverb (of source) from G3837; from all directions:--from every quarter.
BiblicalUsage: Pantachothen means from every quarter, from all directions. After the cleansed leper spreads the news abroad, Jesus can no more openly enter into the city, but is without in desert places, and they come to Him from every quarter.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the crowds coming from every quarter show what mercy does: one healed leper tells everyone, and the whole countryside comes to find Jesus.
